cohort: Women diagnosed with early- and late-onset severe preeclampsia between January 2013 and January 2014 who underwent pregnancy termination at Dr. Soetomo General Hospital, Surabaya.
finding: Women with early-onset severe preeclampsia had a significantly higher risk of developing cardiovascular risk factors, particularly hypertension and metabolic syndrome, 5 years after diagnosis compared to those with late-onset severe preeclampsia.
